actions.article_title: Checkout CTA Microcopy: Urgency Framing Increases Completion (synthetic case study)
actions.summary_for_business: Cambiar el texto del boton de checkout de 'Continue' a 'Complete secure purchase' aumento la tasa de finalizacion de compra en un estudio sintetico multi-sitio.
pros: Cambio de bajo coste de implementacion (solo copy, sin rediseno de flujo).
El anclaje textual reporta una muestra relativamente grande (1240 sesiones) para el tipo de test.
Coherente con patrones de microcopy de urgencia ya documentados en literatura de UX.
actions.recommended_action: Adopt the urgency-based checkout CTA as the new default for the checkout button.
actions.business_context: The checkout team wants to reduce abandonment on the final payment step without increasing opt-outs or customer friction.
actions.result_summary: The urgency CTA improved checkout completion versus the current default.

synthetic_previous_action.summary: The current checkout button uses neutral copy and serves as the baseline experience.

actions.article_title: Abandoned Cart Email Timing: 1-Hour Beats 24-Hour Delay (synthetic case study)
actions.summary_for_business: Enviar el email de carrito abandonado tras 1 hora en vez de 24 horas mejoro la tasa de recuperacion en un panel sintetico.
pros: Cambio puramente de configuracion (timing de envio), sin coste de desarrollo adicional.
El efecto reportado es consistente con la intuicion de recencia en comportamiento de compra.
actions.recommended_action: Switch the abandoned-cart trigger from 24 hours to 1 hour after abandonment.
actions.business_context: CRM wants to recover more carts while keeping unsubscribe risk within the normal weekly range.
actions.result_summary: The 1-hour email timing recovered more carts than the current 24-hour sequence.

synthetic_previous_action.summary: The current abandoned-cart program waits 24 hours before sending the first recovery email.

pros: Lift positivo respecto al baseline original, aunque menor que la variante ya activa.

actions.article_title: Exit-Intent Discount Popups: Balancing Recovery and Margin (synthetic case study)
actions.summary_for_business: Popup de descuento del 10% al detectar intencion de salida; podria recuperar visitantes a punto de abandonar el sitio.
pros: Palanca distinta (exit_intent_discount_popup) a las ya activas; no choca con la regla anti-obsolescencia.
Efecto de recuperacion citado es significativo en relacion al volumen de abandono.
actions.recommended_action: Approve a controlled test of the exit-intent popup on high-abandonment sessions only.
actions.business_context: Merchandising wants to recover abandoning visitors without eroding margin across the full site.

actions.article_title: Low-Stock Urgency Badges on Product Pages (synthetic mock trial)
actions.summary_for_business: Badge de 'Solo quedan 3 unidades' en pagina de producto para aumentar la tasa de anadir al carrito.
pros: Palanca distinta y de bajo coste de implementacion (etiqueta de stock).
actions.recommended_action: Test urgency badges only on low-stock products with stable fulfillment confidence.
actions.business_context: Product pages need a clearer urgency cue, but operations must avoid false scarcity signals.
guardrails: Only show on confirmed low-stock SKUs

actions.article_title: Free Shipping Threshold Banner Placement (synthetic in-progress test)
actions.summary_for_business: Banner de umbral de envio gratis mostrado sobre el resumen del carrito; test en curso con senal preliminar positiva pero aun sin potencia suficiente.
pros: Senal preliminar positiva en valor medio de pedido (AOV).
actions.recommended_action: Keep the test running until the banner reaches sufficient sample size before any business decision.
actions.business_context: The basket team is testing whether a better free-shipping reminder can raise average order value without harming conversion.
actions.result_summary: The banner shows an early positive signal, but there is not enough evidence yet to decide.

actions.article_title: Checkout Progress Indicator: Step Count Transparency (synthetic desk review)
actions.summary_for_business: Mostrar '2 de 3 pasos completados' en el checkout para reducir el abandono por incertidumbre sobre la duracion del proceso.
pros: Palanca nueva, no cubierta por ninguna accion activa.
Reduce incertidumbre del proceso, un driver de abandono bien documentado en UX de checkout.
actions.recommended_action: Approve a lightweight design review and then test the progress indicator in checkout.
actions.business_context: Checkout wants to reduce uncertainty about remaining steps without adding visual noise.
